entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: An ancient vampire planeswalker, creator of Avacyn and the Helvault, who seeks Olivia Voldaren's aid against a threat to Innistrad.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A powerful ancient vampire, the Voldaren progenitor with red curls who hosts lavish feasts and mocks Sorin before agreeing to help for a price.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A kor lithomancer and planeswalker from Zendikar, once Sorin's protege, who resealed the Eldrazi titans and comes to Innistrad angry that Sorin abandoned her.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel created by Sorin to protect Innistrad, who attacks Nahiri as a planar threat.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Sorin's grandfather, ancestor of the Markov bloodline.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A being who also did not answer Nahiri's signal; Sorin tells her to go find him.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Sorin's plane, protected by the Helvault and Avacyn.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's home plane, where the Eldrazi were imprisoned and broke free.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: Sorin's ancestral manor, now in ruins.

entities.name: Castle Falkenrath
entities.description: The seat of the Falkenrath bloodline, which Olivia says Avacyn destroyed.

entities.name: Voldaren Estate
entities.description: Olivia's remote estate with a ballroom and long dining hall where vampires feast.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: A monolithic chunk of silver from the plane's silver moon that Sorin brought to Innistrad as half of its protection.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The place on Zendikar from which Nahiri sent a signal that never reached Sorin.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Imprisoned monstrosities on Zendikar who broke free and were resealed by Nahiri.

entities.name: Vampires
entities.description: The vampires of Innistrad, including the Voldaren and Markov bloodlines, gathered at Olivia's party.

events.summary: Sorin walks through Olivia Voldaren's masked ballroom to confront her.
events.quote: A hundred or more pairs of eyes watched him from behind elegant masks as he made his way across the ballroom.

events.summary: Olivia mocks Sorin and orders him thrown out, saying the scion of Edgar Markov is not welcome.
events.quote: The scion of Edgar Markov is not welcome here

events.summary: Sorin cuts down five of Olivia's vampires and blasts the last, a duelist, to ash with a clenched fist.
events.quote: his assailant's body burst apart in a scattering of ashes

events.summary: Sorin tells Olivia he has come for her help.
events.quote: I have come for your help.

events.summary: Sorin tells Olivia that his grandfather's manor is in ruins; Olivia blames Avacyn and says she destroyed Castle Falkenrath.
events.quote: She's already destroyed Castle Falkenrath and scattered that bloodline.

events.summary: Flashback: Sorin, still weakened from creating Avacyn, is pulled from his restoration by the arrival of another planeswalker.
events.quote: Something had pulled him prematurely from his restoration.

events.summary: Flashback: Sorin finds the lithomancer Nahiri beside the Helvault.
Flashback: Nahiri says the Eldrazi broke free of their bonds and she resealed their prison alone.
events.quote: With all the strength I could muster, I managed to reseal the titans' prison.

events.summary: Flashback: Sorin explains the Helvault is half of what he created to protect Innistrad, perhaps blocking her signal.
events.quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such protection.

events.summary: Flashback: Nahiri accuses Sorin of abandoning her and breaking their agreement; Sorin dismisses her, recalling that he took her under his wing.
events.quote: When your Planeswalker spark first ignited, it was I who discovered you.

events.summary: Sorin tells Olivia he created Avacyn to protect the world, and that a dangerous person has come to threaten it.
events.quote: I created her to be this world's protector.

events.summary: Flashback: Nahiri raises a field of floating stones, forges a sword from stone and demands Sorin return with her to Zendikar.
events.quote: You will return with me to Zendikar.

events.summary: Flashback: Avacyn tears through the clouds and crashes into Nahiri to protect Innistrad.
events.quote: the archangel who came barreling into her with enough force to carry both figures off the stone column.

events.summary: Flashback: Nahiri overpowers Avacyn with her sword, driving her back.
Flashback: Sorin blocks Nahiri's sword, disarms her and holds a blade to her throat, ending the fight.
events.quote: Sorin brought the point of his blade up to her throat.

events.summary: Sorin asks Olivia to summon her bloodline to join the Markov remnants against the threat.
events.quote: Summon the might of your bloodline, Olivia.

events.summary: Olivia agrees to help Sorin, on the condition that he first helps her.
events.quote: I will help you. But first you will help me.

relations.note: Sorin made her as protector of Innistrad.
relations.quote: I created her to be this world's protector.

relations.note: The Helvault is half of his protection for Innistrad.
relations.quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such protection.

relations.note: He claims to have molded her after discovering her newly ignited spark.
relations.quote: I took you under my wing, and molded you into what you are.
My grandfather's manor is no more.

relations.note: Estranged since what she calls his treachery, but she agrees to bargain.
relations.quote: We haven't spoken since your treachery

relations.note: She promised to watch over them as their warden on Zendikar.
relations.quote: I promised to chain myself to Zendikar to watch over them as their warden.

relations.note: Avacyn attacks Nahiri as a planar threat.
relations.quote: the archangel who came barreling into her with enough force to carry both figures off the stone column.
She's already destroyed Castle Falkenrath and scattered that bloodline.
